trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[r:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)-[:LocatedIn]->(c:City), (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t) WHERE r.tenure = 'latest' AND EXISTS { MATCH (p)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) } AND EXISTS { MATCH (t)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) } AND EXISTS { MATCH (c)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) } AND EXISTS { MATCH (o)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) } RETURN CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS INT64) AS col1, p.name AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, o.name AS col4, c.state_name AS col5, p.name AS name_player, t.team_name AS name_team, c.city_name AS name_city
